svg.text: Figure 1 | Deep learning for antimicrobial peptide (AMP) prediction. Numbered panels follow the workflow: AMP structural biology (amphipathic helices, membrane disruption), dual feature tracks

(hand-crafted descriptors + protein-language-model embeddings), and CNN / BiLSTM / Transformer architectures, evaluated by cross-validation, ROC–AUC and MCC, driving genome-scale screening, generative design and validation.
